# SongIQ

> SongIQ is a free online music quiz game where players guess songs from audio clips. It supports solo and real-time multiplayer modes across genres like Afrobeats, Amapiano, Pop, Hip-Hop, R&B, and more.

## About

SongIQ is a browser-based music trivia game. Players listen to short audio previews and guess the song title or artist from multiple-choice options. The game features a scoring system based on speed and accuracy.

## Game Modes

- **Solo Play**: Practice on your own with curated playlists across multiple genres. Choose a category, listen to clips, and try to beat your high score.
- **Multiplayer**: Create or join a room with friends. Compete in real-time, see live leaderboards, and crown the music champion.

## Supported Genres

- Afrobeats
- Amapiano
- Pop
- Hip-Hop
- R&B
- Gospel
- Highlife
- And more

- Platform: Web (browser-based, no download required)
- Price: Free to play
- Authentication: Anonymous sessions for quick play
- Real-time: Live multiplayer with instant score updates
